summary: Physics-Based VR Hands Purged by default kinematic SDF bridge; legacy ArticulationBody/Rigidbody hand proxy remains behind explicit useKinematicSdfHandBridge=false fallback only.
legacyProxyGuard: PhysicalHandController creates ArticulationBody and Rigidbody shell only when useKinematicSdfHandBridge is false.
hotPathAmendments: Fixed-step fallback uses cached IDataVault plus TryResolveExisting only; no hot GlobalRegistry polling or Vault lane creation.
Live controller pose is written into VRControllerMatrixDTO before shared ingestion math creates VRHandStateDTO.
Socket scan reads all active rows to keep interaction truth independent of GlobalQualityWeight.
Over-budget frames are telemetry-flagged only; non-finite state dumps immediately through the fault-only black box.
continuousQuality: GlobalQualityWeight maps continuously to a 2..8 presentation/telemetry iteration hint; authoritative SDF truth uses the deterministic 8-step fence so rollback state, DTO layout, and authority route remain invariant.
